description: Expected packaging behaviour per .viza package mode. The first-wedge run intentionally exercises all 3 user-listed modes (white_box, output_only, marketplace_draft) plus 3 additional Phase-30/35 modes (gray_box, black_box, preview) for completeness.

contains.entities: all (company, issuer, equity_security, listing, filing, evidence_bundle, thesis, valuation_models, decision, validation_record, rights_policy)
contains.attributes: all 15 attribute records with raw values + computation methods
contains.insights: all 7 insights with full evidence chains and per-profile interpretations

contains.methodology_graph: redacted to node-type-and-edge-type level (no internal config payloads)
contains.entities: public_official entities (company, issuer, equity_security, listing, filing, evidence_bundle) preserved; internal_research_only entities (thesis, valuation_models, decision) shown as redacted placeholders with attribution + invalidation summary
contains.attributes: filing-derived attributes preserved with raw values; computed valuation attributes (margin_of_safety_pct, valuation_gap_pct) shown as bands not exact numbers
contains.validation_record: passed/warn/fail counts + warning codes preserved; raw rule_results table redacted

gray_box.intended_audience: trusted reviewer who has read-only entitlement

contains.methodology_graph: blinded - rendered as opaque computational box
contains.outputs: equity_radar + investment_memo + validation_report + source_rights_report (rendered, with all internal_research_only sections redacted)

black_box.intended_audience: downstream consumer who needs the result but not the method

contains.entities: only those referenced in the rendered outputs (security identity + listing for the radar / memo header)
contains.outputs: equity_radar + investment_memo + validation_report + source_rights_report (rendered, with all internal_research_only sections redacted; thesis claim shown as 1-line summary; valuation values shown as ranges; decision rationale redacted)

output_only.intended_audience: exchange recipient who wants results + audit

contains.outputs: equity_radar sample (top-3 risk_flags + action class + non_advice_boundary)

contains.methodology_graph: absent (creator may upgrade if redaction is documented)
contains.registry_artifacts: manifest only with public_official artifacts visible
contains.entities: public_official entities only (company display_name, sector, industry, listing); internal_research_only entities REDACTED as placeholders with attribution + invalidation summary only

outputs.equity_radar: action_class + score band + confidence_label + risk_flag_count + non_advice_boundary
outputs.investment_memo: header + non_advice_boundary + executive_summary_1_line + thesis_redacted + risks_summary + invalidation_conditions_count + open_questions
outputs.source_rights_report: full (this report IS the rights view)

marketplace_draft.intended_audience: creator review / future exchange recipient (not monetized)

package_acceptance_checks.check: white_box never exposes restricted_or_unclear license sources
package_acceptance_checks.note: no restricted_or_unclear sources present in this fixture

package_acceptance_checks.check: marketplace_draft redacts every internal_research_only entity field listed in redaction_targets
marketplace_draft preserves non_advice_boundary on every section
no_monetized_marketplace endpoint referenced in any package

non_advice_boundary: These package outputs are research artefacts produced against fictional fixture data. They do not constitute investment advice. ExampleCo Industrial, Inc. is fictional; no real issuer is represented.
